source_data.desc: This fruity mead is the color of liquid gold and is rumored to be brewed with a tear from the goddess of bearfolk herself. When you drink this mead, you regenerate lost hit points for 1 minute. At the start of your turn, you regain 10 hit points if you have at least 1 hit point.
source_data.name: Maiden's Tears

en.description: This fruity mead is the color of liquid gold and is rumored to be brewed with a tear from the goddess of bearfolk herself. When you drink this mead, you regenerate lost hit points for 1 minute. At the start of your turn, you regain 10 hit points if you have at least 1 hit point.
en.name: Maiden's Tears

ru.description: Этот фруктовый мёд цвета жидкого золота и, по слухам, сварен со слезой самой богини медвежьего народа. Когда вы пьёте этот мёд, вы регенерируете потерянные хиты в течение 1 минуты. В начале вашего хода вы восстанавливаете 10 хитов, если у вас есть не менее 1 хита.
ru.name: Слёзы девы
